title: Why do I have to brush them two times?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: It's time to brush your teeth now.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Why do I have to brush them two times?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Because little sugar bugs are hiding on your teeth. Brushing chases them away.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But I brushed them last night!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The bugs come back while you sleep. That's why we brush every morning too.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: And why do I have to use the toothpaste too?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Toothpaste makes your teeth strong and shiny. The bugs can't hold on.

variations: "brush twice" 换 "go to bed now"；"toothpaste" 换 "the foam one"。
